digest.component_or_area: complexity gate and production code quality ratchet
propositions: Add a shrink-only complexity baseline that prevents new or increased cyclomatic complexity debt while permitting improvements and stale ceiling removal.
Implement a wrapper script that compares live Ruff C901 findings against recorded per-function ceilings and fails only on new/increased complexity or operational errors.
Establish an immutable baseline JSON schema with normalized filepath::qualified-symbol keys and strict validation to prevent unauthorized regression.
Guard a maintenance mode (--update-stale) that can only lower ceilings or remove entries, refusing to bless new or increased complexity debt.
Wire the complexity wrapper into make lint so production code under src/rebar is governed by the ratchet while test and lint scopes remain unchanged.
